sheet.title: Your procedures on consulat.ga
sheet.separate: consulat.ga is another application, with its own sign-in: DIASPORA.GA sends it nothing.
sheet.sameTab: These links open consulat.ga in this tab.
sheet.idnLead: Your account is linked to your digital identity: you can also use it to sign in to consulat.ga.
sheet.stepsLead: To carry out your procedures on consulat.ga, three steps:

steps.identityBody: It proves who you are, on identite.ga.
steps.registrationBody: You register with the consulate of your country of residence.
steps.accessBody: You then follow your procedures in your consulat.ga space.

sheet.registerCreatesIdentity: Registering with the consulate creates your digital identity at the same time.

arrival.doorHint: Sign in with the same digital identity, or with a code sent by email.

passage.failed: We couldn’t open your Diaspora session
passage.retryInfo: Return to your consular account to try again with your current session.
passage.downloadIntro: Join your community in the app or continue in your browser with your consular session.
passage.later: The apps will appear here when they are released.
passage.laterIos: The iOS app will appear here when it is released.
passage.laterAndroid: The Android app will appear here when it is released.
